semanticBoundaryReview.decisionSummary: The 27 numbered section instances plus one short preamble are accepted as coarse, hash-bound classification units. The unrecognized Word Title style causes several section instances to contain multiple authored articles; those units must be marked uncertain and split before atomic opinion import. This is an engineering boundary decision, not clinical approval.

The document currently has two unsectioned parser chunks rather than reviewed authored-unit boundaries. It remains lexically indexed but cannot enter semantic drafting until a whole-document or contiguous-unit boundary is explicitly accepted.
